messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 37(4)

Article 37 Challenge of the competence of notified bodies. 4. Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification, it shall adopt an implementing act requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures, including the withdrawal of the notification if necessary. That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the advisory procedure referred to in Article 48(2).

response.text:
Commission | shall adopt implementing act requesting corrective measures | notifying Member State | Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification | "it shall adopt an implementing act requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures"
notifying Member State | shall take necessary corrective measures | corrective measures including withdrawal of notification | when requested by Commission implementing act | "requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures, including the withdrawal of the notification if necessary"
withdrawal of notification | may be included in corrective measures | notifying Member State's corrective measures | if necessary | "including the withdrawal of the notification if necessary"
implementing act under Art. 37(4) | shall be adopted under | advisory procedure referred to in Article 48(2) | "" | "That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the advisory procedure referred to in Article 48(2)"
